title: Paris answers; Helen laments
intro: Paris accepts the rebuke but speaks lightly of alternating victory. Helen wishes her life had ended at birth.

notes.text: δαιμόνιος voc sg, “strange / misguided man,” tone depends on context; καλά adv., rightly / well, negated.
ἐντίθημι, put in: 2sg aor mid, here past indicative without augment, “you have lodged this anger in your heart.”
φθινύθω, perish / waste away: 3pl pres; πτόλις = πόλις, epic form.
μάρναμαι, fight: pres mid ptc; σέο = σοῦ, εἵνεκα = ἕνεκα, because of you.
ἀϋτή, battle-cry; ἀμφιδαίω, blaze around: 3sg perf act, continuing fire; war has flared about Troy.
μάχομαι 2sg aor mid opt + ἄν, “you would quarrel”; εἶδον 2sg 2aor opt in indefinite relative, anyone you saw.
μεθίημι, slacken / withdraw from: pres act ptc acc sg + gen; στυγερός, hateful.
ἄνα, up!; θέρω, heat / burn: 3sg pres pass subj, apprehension “lest the city soon burn.” δήϊος, destructive.
According to due measure … beyond it; αἶσα, allotted share / propriety. Paris accepts the rebuke as fair.
τοῦ ἕνεκα, therefore; συντίθημι 2sg aor mid imperative, attend / take heed.
μευ = μου; ἀκούω 2sg aor imperative + gen of person.
χόλος, anger; νέμεσις, indignation: dat sg, cause; ἧμαι 1sg impf, sat. He denies sulking in anger at the Trojans.
ἄχος, grief: dat sg; προτρέπω 2aor mid inf, give oneself over to / indulge grief.
παρεῖπον aor ptc nom fem sg, speaking persuasively; ὁρμάω 3sg aor, roused him; Helen the subject.
λώϊον, better: neut comparative; εἰμί fut inf after δοκέει. “Seems better to me too.”
ἐπαμείβομαι, pass from one to another: 3sg pres mid; victory changes hands, Paris' reassuring maxim.
ἐπιμένω 2sg aor imperative, wait; δύω 1sg aor subj, “let me put on”; Ἀρήϊα τεύχεα, armour of war.
μέτειμι (εἶμι), will follow / go after; κιχάνω, catch up: fut mid inf; σε object, subject “I” understood.
μειλίχιος, gentle / soothing: dat pl with words.
δαήρ, husband's brother: voc sg; Helen addresses Hector.
ἐμεῖο = ἐμοῦ; κύων, dog, self-abusive “shameless woman”; κακομήχανος, scheming evil; ὀκρυόεις, horrible / chilling, gen fem sg.
ὀφείλω 3sg aor, wish that an unreal past had occurred; θύελλα subject, “if only a storm had carried me away.”
προφέρω, bear away / sweep along: pres ptc nom fem sg with storm.
πολύφλοισβος, loud-roaring: gen sg with sea; φλοῖσβος, surf-roar.
ἀποέρδω, sweep away: 3sg aor; πάρος + inf, before; γίγνομαι 2aor mid inf. Waves should have taken her before these deeds.
τεκμαίρομαι, determine / ordain: 3pl aor mid; gods ordained these troubles.
ὀφείλω 1sg impf in unreal wish, “I ought / wish to have been”; ἄκοιτις, wife; ἀμείνονος, of a better man.
οἶδα epic 3sg plup, knew / understood; αἶσχος, reproach / disgrace: acc pl. She wishes Paris felt others' disapproval.
